subtopic: Private Fund Advice vs. Advice to Individuals
source_evidence: An SEC-exempt reporting adviser can only provide investment advice to private funds and cannot legally provide investment advice directly to individuals.
answer: An exempt reporting adviser (ERA) has a specific limit on whom it may advise: it can provide investment advice to private funds, but it cannot legally advise individuals directly. This distinction describes the permitted clients of an SEC-exempt reporting adviser; it does not mean that every adviser to a private fund is an ERA.
